rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a material substantive and rhetorical template: it presents accelerated, already planned and needed public improvements as an anti-recession measure, ties action to unemployment and changing economic conditions, and details Federal public works, State assistance, housing finance, and unemployment relief. The child converts that same approach into a formal standby program with objective triggers. C24 is also closely related because it establishes advance Federal-State-local public-works planning specifically to permit acceleration when economic conditions warrant, but less of its administrative machinery appears in the child. C12 supplies the related standby anti-recession concept and unemployment focus, though for compensation rather than capital improvements.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The authorization or acceleration of special programs or expenditures—including those for capital improvements or community facilities
shared_material.parent_excerpt: certain kinds of governmental measures, including the acceleration of planned and needed public improvements, can be helpful in promoting increased growth of the economy
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared formulation of accelerated public improvements as a countercyclical economic tool.

shared_material.child_excerpt: An acceleration of these projects—all worthwhile in their own right—is a wise and proper method of increasing employment and expenditures
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Administration has been developing additional orderly accelerations of programs that are genuinely needed in the public interest, have long been planned, and are already approved
shared_material.explanation: Both stress accelerating independently worthwhile, preplanned public projects rather than inventing make-work projects.

shared_material.child_excerpt: provide stand-by authority to the President to initiate a temporary expansion in Federal and Federally-aided public works programs
shared_material.parent_excerpt: should additional governmental measures be needed, they will be taken by the Executive Branch or proposed to the Congress
shared_material.explanation: The child formalizes C13's contingent executive-and-legislative response into statutory standby authority.
